video_title: If you swapped Jalen Brunson with Shai the OKC Thunder beat the Spurs 👀

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton argues Jalen Brunson would beat the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: If you take Shai off the Thunder and replace him with Jalen Brunson, the Thunder beat the Spurs.
quotes.quote: I know Shai didn't have a second best player. This is a real thing. He was the Finals MVP the year before and he's been a very clutch player. If you take Shai off the Thunder and replace him with Jalen Brunson, the Thunder beat the Spurs. The Thunder beat the Spurs. Same guys defended Shai that tried to defend Brunson. They had some success early in the series and limited Brunson's offense. Brunson is one of those players, and the Knicks are a special team, but he's really the number one reason why, though there are others.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Debating if Jalen Brunson or Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is better
quotes.excerpt: I don't truly understand. First of all, you two played the game at a high, high level.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I don't truly understand. First of all, you two played the game at a high, high level. Does health matter?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: We said it. When I said it, it was an excuse.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: What do you mean? We're talking about the team?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Yeah, because you said it was an excuse.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: For who? I said it was an excuse. But now you're using it. But what I'm telling you is you can't say that about them, though. You're trying to flip-flop somebody.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva argues the Knicks lose without OG Anunoby and Mitchell Robinson
quotes.excerpt: I don't think the Knicks win if OG and Mitchell are out.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I don't think the Knicks win if OG and Mitchell are out.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: You don't. You don't. It's the same equivalent.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson notes Chet Holmgren was spooked in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: Chet was so spooked though, bro. Like that's a big part.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Chet was so spooked though, bro. Like that's a big part.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: But still, there's two other best offensive players who can create. They didn't have. Like Jalen had OG to pick up his slack. Game two, Jared McCain missed one fucking shot.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson praises Jalen Brunson's performance in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson was shooting awful. Couldn't make a shot and Cat kept him in the fucking game.
quotes.quote: We remember Jalen Brunson was shooting awful. Couldn't make a shot and Cat kept him in the fucking game. So my thing is health matters. I think everyone understands that I was a big advocate for the San Antonio Spurs. I just loved what they were doing. But OKC not going nowhere at all. They are they are a great they have great front office, great coaching, great players. Chet's going to learn from it. At the end of the day, he don't got a choice but to learn from it. I think he has the competitive nature to be better.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva explains Max Kellerman's argument about Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: Max Kellerman's context is that JB is a better player in the clutch.
quotes.quote: Basically, Max Kellerman's context, and that's what more so they're saying, is that JB is a better player in the clutch because he closed out clutch games and there's a bunch of close games.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is better than Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: We still got Shai better than Jalen Brunson.
quotes.quote: We still got Shai better than Jalen Brunson. Did they guard Shai solo? No, they had a double team. You couldn't double team Jalen because OG, Mitchell, and Shamet were on the floor. For them, the only shooter they had was Jared McCain. You were living if Brunson shot the ball.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson defends Shai Gilgeous-Alexander against playoff criticism
quotes.excerpt: Ain't nobody are struggling when they double team you. They double every series.
quotes.quote: Everybody was like, if you listen to the people talk, they were like, oh, Shai is struggling in the playoffs. Ain't nobody are struggling when they double team you. They double every series. Except for Kobe. Except for the Mamba. Well, Kobe would still shoot that bitch with the double team. He would triple team. He said, bring another one. You better bring another one. That's why there's levels. That's why people don't understand why I put those guys so far up here because they didn't care what you did. Double team me, triple team me, I'm still going to give you 30 and we still going to win this game.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson discusses the Spurs' playoff performance
quotes.excerpt: Shai also hasn't had to play a lot of fourth quarters because they were fucking up.
quotes.quote: But Shai also hasn't had to play a lot of fourth quarters because they were fucking up. Not last year. They were beating the shit out of people. Except for Nuggets. Also, I don't know if you remember, but damn near every game was a blowout against the Spurs. It was either a blowout for the Spurs or a blowout for OKC until game seven.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the difficulty of judging point guards
quotes.excerpt: The point guard position is the hardest position to judge in the game of basketball.
quotes.quote: The point guard position is the hardest position to judge in the game of basketball. Point blank, period. You guys are determined on your team more than the point guard and the center position are determined on their team, no matter what. It does not fucking matter.
